description: What the service needs to issue a credential: the service and its languages, from the transcript's profile; the model, from the transcript; and the audio and protocols, from the software.

allOf.description: Base schema for all adapter request payloads. Defines the metadata passthrough field that the blueprint sets for correlation. Adapters must echo it back unchanged in the response — they must not inspect or depend on its contents.

metadata.description: Opaque correlation context set by the blueprint. Echo back unchanged in the response. The adapter must not inspect or modify this field.

provider.description: The transcription service, an entry of the transcription-services registry.

model.description: The service's model, for a service that fixes it when issuing the credential.

languages.description: The languages the conversation may be in. The adapter maps them to what its service takes — one, a list, or none to detect — and answers 422 when it can't. Absent, the service detects the language, if it can.

audio.description: The audio the software will send. Some services fix it into the credential — Amazon Transcribe signs the sample rate into its URL — so the software says it before connecting, in a format its service takes.

encoding.description: How the audio is encoded, by Google Cloud Speech-to-Text's encoding names in the blueprint's casing, which fix the bit depth: linear16 is 16-bit signed little-endian PCM.

channelCount.description: Channels in the audio. One means the service tells speakers apart by voice; more, that each speaker is on a channel of their own, as a phone call recorded with each side on its own channel is.

items.description: How the software connects to the service.

protocols.description: The protocols the software can connect over. The adapter answers with one of them.
